principle: Pattern is evidence, not permission. Production entry requires pattern + market state + capacity + confirmation + fee edge.

patterns.logic: bullish candle body engulfs previous bearish body
patterns.confirmation: close above pattern high or positive follow-through; prefer support/reclaim context

patterns.logic: bearish candle body engulfs previous bullish body
patterns.confirmation: close below pattern low or negative follow-through; prefer resistance/rejection context

patterns.logic: long lower wick, small body near candle high after weakness
patterns.confirmation: next close holds/reclaims; avoid raw hammer in strong downside expansion

patterns.logic: long upper wick, small body near candle low after strength
patterns.confirmation: next close rejects high; avoid raw star in strong upside expansion

patterns.logic: bearish impulse + indecision + bullish recovery
patterns.confirmation: third close reclaims meaningful fraction of first body

patterns.logic: bullish impulse + indecision + bearish recovery
patterns.confirmation: third close rejects meaningful fraction of first body

patterns.logic: up impulse + shallow/contracting pause + break of pause high
patterns.confirmation: break-hold or retest-renewal; no one-bar chase

patterns.logic: down impulse + shallow/contracting pause + break of pause low
patterns.confirmation: break-hold or retest-renewal; no one-bar chase

patterns.logic: rising fast EMA above slow EMA; price pulls to EMA and reclaims
patterns.confirmation: directional close + momentum renewal

patterns.logic: falling fast EMA below slow EMA; price rallies to EMA and rejects
patterns.confirmation: directional close + momentum renewal

patterns.logic: price crosses/reclaims VWAP after trading below
patterns.confirmation: hold above VWAP plus follow-through; raw VWAP cross forbidden

patterns.logic: price tests/rejects VWAP after trading below or loses it after failed reclaim
patterns.confirmation: hold below VWAP plus downside follow-through

patterns.logic: Bollinger bandwidth contracts then expands with upside close
patterns.confirmation: ATR/volume/capacity expansion and no immediate return inside range

patterns.logic: Bollinger bandwidth contracts then expands with downside close
patterns.confirmation: ATR/volume/capacity expansion and no immediate return inside range

patterns.logic: price lower low while RSI makes higher low
patterns.confirmation: reclaim/engulf/structure break; divergence alone is not entry

patterns.logic: price higher high while RSI makes lower high
patterns.confirmation: rejection/engulf/structure break; divergence alone is not entry

patterns.logic: MACD histogram turns up / bullish cross in non-range context
patterns.confirmation: price displacement and capacity

patterns.logic: MACD histogram turns down / bearish cross in non-range context
patterns.confirmation: price displacement and capacity

patterns.logic: stochastic exits oversold in range/slow trend
patterns.confirmation: support/reclaim; disabled in strong trend without reversal structure

patterns.logic: stochastic exits overbought in range/slow trend
patterns.confirmation: resistance/rejection; disabled in strong trend without reversal structure

patterns.logic: large directional move + controlled pause + renewed directional flow
patterns.confirmation: positive follow-through; preferred DARA continuation pattern

patterns.logic: large directional move + controlled pause + renewed directional flow
patterns.confirmation: negative follow-through; stronger downside expansion required
